name: gatherly-event-management

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server

description: Gatherly is a production-minded MERN monorepo starter for discovering, submitting, moderating, and booking events. The client currently includes a polished, responsive product experience with local demo state so the flows are immediately explorable; the server contains the typed API boundaries and Mongoose model foundation for wiring MongoDB and JWT auth.
